Brave's independent web index: web, news, images, videos, places, LLM context and answers.

## API key

1. Open [api-dashboard.search.brave.com](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** Activate a plan (it includes $5 of free credit a month), then create a key under API Keys.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add brave-search
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  "brave-search": { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Brave Search's [API](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show brave-search` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Search $5 per 1k requests; Answers $4 per 1k plus $5 per million tokens; $5 free credit a month; only successful calls count.

**Rate limits:** 50 calls a second. Search plan 50 queries per second; Answers 2 per second.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Brave%20Search).
